3. Read the specification (if required/available) and determine the correct specification value (e.g. take the 3 decimals value from the specification value “35.145” instead of using “35.1450034” from the test).
4. Read the full specification value (e.g. “35.145” if and only if the test value is not to the 3 decimals). This is important for correct value interpretation by the end user.
5. Render the format specification without the “=” symbol (e.g. “A35.145”) to avoid the value being interpreted as double the specification.
